test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 07 March 2023)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in a sentence.**

Even though James won the election, he has not brought any of his campaign promises to __fruition__.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Accomplishment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence, the word **"fruition"** is used to describe the lack of fulfillment of James' campaign promises, indicating that he has not been able to achieve or bring them to completion.
 
• **Fruition **means** the realization or fulfilment of a plan or project.** 
 
 
• Example: The plans have come to **fruition **rather sooner than expected
 
 
 
• **Accomplishment **means the successful achievement of a task.
 
 
• Example: The **accomplishment **of planned objectives.
 
 
 
• Therefore, **"accomplishment"** is the most appropriate meaning of the word in this context. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, concealment, **does not fit the context of the sentence as there is no indication of James hiding anything.
 
• **Option 2, nourishment,** is also irrelevant as it does not relate to the sentence's context.
 
• **Option 3, disappointment,** is also incorrect as it refers to 'the state of being unhappy because something that you hoped for or expected did not happen.'
